evidence.excerpt: We release the test set of Rashi-script documents so that it may be used as a benchmark for future work in this area.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: We further demonstrate that DictaRashi outperforms the current frontier LLMs on this OCR task.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On a held-out set of 1,120 manually transcribed lines from scanned Rashi-script pages, DictaRashi reaches a character error rate (CER) of 0.86% and a word error rate (WER) of 3.38%, setting a new state-of-the-art for publicly-available Tesseract models.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We provide a full comparison of our results to those of the 31 other publicly available Hebrew Tesseract models; the best of those models achieves a 2.98% CER and 11.86% WER.
